q: What is the most important thing you learned these days?
a:
One of the most important things I have learned these days is that keeping a positive mindset has a strong impact on my daily life.

Even when situations don’t go as planned, focusing on the positive side, from a stoic point of view, helps me stay calm and think more clearly.

It also helps me concentrate on what I can control instead of worrying about things I cannot change. Because of this, I feel more productive and mentally stronger in my daily life.
